steps.title: Solution
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{Yes, }0\text{ is a rational number. A}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{rational number is of the form }\frac{p}{q}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{where p, q are integers and }q\ne 0.\text{ We}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{can write }0=\frac{0}{1}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(here }p=0\text{ and }q=1,\text{ both integers and }q\ne 0).\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Hence }0\in Q.\end{aligned}\]
